spec2def(wer.dll wer.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# wer.dll is all Rust (wer-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wer-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# Written in Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wer-rust): wer.dll (WER API, no WER service); port of Wine's dlls/wer/main.c.
# The target keeps a stub TU and links the Rust archive.
add_cargo_module(wer wer-cargo wer.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wer-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
